text:
maya: quick check  Samir is currently on OPT and was approved for H-1 change of status but there's a small EAD gap between OPT end 2026-06-30 and H-1 effective 2026-07-10. can ppl-ops confirm payroll, benefits, and PTO handling?
samir: hi, yes OPT EAD expires 6/30. employer filed timely COS and we expect H-1 start 7/10 per counsel. worried about health coverage gap and PTO accrual.
elaine: short answer: payroll needs active work authorization for I-9. if there's a gap with no payroll, benefits vendor will terminate coverage at end of the month unless COBRA or special coverage applies. PTO and equity vesting anchor to payroll start date; unpaid gap doesn't count as employment for accrual.
ravi: legal note: change-of-status pending with USCIS may allow cap-gap extension if an H-1 was filed while OPT valid; check receipt dates. if there's genuine 9-day gap, counsel recommends documenting the gap and considering short-term options (COBRA, transitional coverage).
maya: team can have Samir continue non-prod onboarding remotely during gap, but no billable work. is there a way to bridge benefits?
elaine: benefits options: 1) COBRA (employee pays full premium) eligible for group plan if terminated; 2) we can discuss short-term employer-paid bridging only in exceptional cases with approval from finance and benefits vendor; 3) some vendors allow administrative continuation for X days if payroll resumes quicklywe'll check.
hr-bot: Note: if payroll end_date = 2026-06-30 and new payroll start = 2026-07-10, benefits vendor will terminate coverage 06-30 and COBRA offer will be triggered.
samir: would company-paid short bridge be possible? medical bills during gap are my main worry.
elaine: we can escalate to finance for a one-time bridging payment or health stipend; need manager sign-off and legal to confirm no taxable surprises. equity and PTO remain tied to payroll dates.
ravi: action items:
- Samir: share OPT EAD card front/back and USCIS receipt number with people-ops portal
- Counsel (Ravi): confirm whether cap-gap extension applies and if receipt triggers automatic bridging within 3 business days
- People-ops (Elaine): ask benefits vendor about short admin continuation and prepare COBRA notice template
- Finance: evaluate one-time health stipend option if vendor cannot bridge
maya: team ok to accommodate limited remote ramp. please keep me posted.
samir: thanks all, uploading docs now. really appreciate the help.
elaine: opening HRIS ticket and setting provisional state = "pending_auth_gap". will DM next steps and COBRA form by EOD tomorrow.
hr-bot: recorded provisional state = "pending_work_auth"; no payroll actions until I-9 clears.
